name: OWASP NodeGoat
notes: NodeGoat is the OWASP project for teaching the OWASP Top 10 in
Node.js. The README maps each lab (A1..A10) to specific CWE
categories. The expected_cwes set below is the subset that a
general-purpose static analyzer should reach with default rules.
Match logic: a CWE entry counts as 'detected' iff secscan emits
at least one finding with that CWE in its location output.
This is the third-party / out-of-sample number — recall here
tells us how well secscan generalizes beyond the curated
fixtures we author ourselves (where we always hit 100%).

expected_cwes.topic: A1 SQL/NoSQL Injection (NodeGoat uses MongoDB ⇒ CWE-943 is the precise category)
A7 XSS (autoescape disabled → secscan custom rule)

out_of_scope_cwes.reason: XXE; uncommon in Node.js default stack
vulnerable components; deps scanner scope, not SAST
insufficient logging; hard to detect statically

Broken Authentication is fundamentally an architecture / workflow concern (session management, account lockout, password reset flow). NodeGoat's user-dao actually uses bcrypt correctly — the 'vulnerability' is at the auth-flow level, not the code-pattern level. SAST cannot detect this class. The dynamic-observation sub-classes (CWE-306/307/384/565) are covered by Phase 2-J DAST active mode (ZAP plugin 40038 'Bypassing 403') and Phase 2-P IAST harness (pyrasp 'ignored_auth' check). Pure-policy sub-classes (CWE-521 password complexity, CWE-613 session timeout) remain out-of-scope for every scanner.
